blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A Belgium-based firm has proposed to build an oil refinery and depot in the Philippines, according to Sen. Erwin Tulfo. According to him, Brightside Industries Group, LLC sent him a letter expressing such intention and stating that the company would not require the Philippines to spend funds for the proposed project.
